metrics.name: Agent Connection Consumption
metrics.gotcha: AgentConnectionConsumption.limit is in BYTES (integer, e.g. 10240000000 = ~10GB). AgentConnectionConsumption.current is also bytes.

metrics.name: Agent Status
metrics.gotcha: Agent.status is an OBJECT with a 'value' key. status.value is ALL-CAPS STRING ('ONLINE', 'OFFLINE'). Do not use lowercase.

metrics.name: API Daily Usage
metrics.gotcha: API object fields: by_ip, by_key, by_resource, daily_limit (number), daily_usage (number), concurrent_allowed (number).

metrics.name: Device Count
metrics.gotcha: Devices[] fields include: id, type, model, names, status (ALL-CAPS string), vendor, details, protocol, is_jammed, hw_address, importance (ALL-CAPS string), DeviceUptime, display_name, grace_period, ip_addresses, first_seen_on, agent_reachable, last_status_change, DeviceStatusHistory.

metrics.name: Device Inventory
metrics.jmesPathQuery: Devices[].{display_name: display_name, status: status, importance: importance, ip_addresses: ip_addresses, hw_address: hw_address, vendor: vendor, model: model}
metrics.gotcha: status and importance are ALL-CAPS strings. display_name, vendor, model are strings. ip_addresses is an array. hw_address is MAC address string.

metrics.name: RTD Statistics
metrics.jmesPathQuery: AgentRTDStats[].{device_id: device_id, avg_median: avg_median, latest_lost_packet_count: latest_lost_packet_count, latest_sent_packet_count: latest_sent_packet_count}
metrics.gotcha: CRITICAL: AgentRTDStats[].device_id is an INTEGER — NOT device_name (which does not exist in this array). Fields confirmed: avg_max, avg_min, device_id (int), timestamp, avg_median, latest_median, latest_lost_packet_count, latest_sent_packet_count.
